claims.value: gpt-oss-safeguard-20b is a 21B parameter safety reasoning model (3.6B active) built upon gpt-oss. It is intended for safety use cases, classifying text based on user-provided policies. It uses the harmony response format and supports configurable reasoning effort levels.
claims.evidence: gpt-oss-safeguard-20b (21B parameters with 3.6B active parameters) fits into GPUs with 16GB of VRAM.
Both models were trained on our harmony response format and should only be used with the harmony format as it will not work correctly otherwise.

claims.value: This model is a fine-tune of the openai/gpt-oss-20b base model.
The model has 21B total parameters and 3.6B active parameters, fitting on GPUs with 16GB VRAM.
